name: Event networking
description: Work an event's attendee portal with your agent. It shortlists people worth meeting from the directory, researches each one and drafts a message; you approve every message before the agent sends it through the event's own chat. Replies, meetings and who was contacted are kept across events, so nobody is approached twice.

deploy.title: Deploy OpenEvents
deploy.subtitle: Your agent works the attendee list of your next event. You approve every message before it goes out.
